review_type: Critical self-review with a separate mathematical implementation for retained-evidence checks; not external peer review
artifact_revision_definition: SHA-256 of json.dumps(reviewed_artifacts, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode(); review and manifest are excluded to avoid self-reference

checks.check: Original capsule integrity and scope of adaptation
checks.establishes: Original files match supplied inputs; only two absolute data paths differ in the adapted source, with no algorithm or parameter changes.
checks.does_not_establish: Equivalence to an unavailable historical software environment.

checks.check: All required scripts actually executed and recording transparency checked
checks.establishes: Each script completed four predictor calls; three direct uninstrumented CLI executions produce identical stdout to the recorded execution.
checks.does_not_establish: Correct interpretation of the printed predictor names without inspecting call arguments.

checks.check: Data, exact seed-42 partition, label alignment, and train-only Wine normalization
checks.establishes: Saved data match source text or Iris CSV in the pinned wheel; disjoint exhaustive partitions match the original random permutation and transformed arrays match the original preprocessing.
checks.does_not_establish: Representative class coverage or independence of duplicated feature vectors.

checks.check: All twelve printed accuracies and six exact question keys recomputed
checks.establishes: Correct/total and two-decimal percentage computed from retained predictions and test labels equal every stdout row; report keys are parsed from the original task.
checks.does_not_establish: Distinct CN/AA experiments for Iris and Zoo, statistical uncertainty, or historical reference agreement.

checks.check: Independent retained-graph predictor scoring and graph constraints
checks.establishes: Independent set/scalar score formulas reproduce all predictions; exact class edges, Manhattan neighbor-boundary admissibility, mandatory closer positive-distance edges, finite scores, and positive observed CS denominators are checked.
checks.does_not_establish: An independent exact tie-breaking reconstruction of the k-NN graph, or correctness beyond the observed inputs.

checks.check: Fresh environment and retained-evidence recomputation commands actually tested
checks.establishes: Fresh offline installation and full execution succeed; raw arrays, graphs, predictions and stdout equal the recovery run; the delivered recompute entry point regenerates the six answers without source experiments.
checks.does_not_establish: Portability to another operating system, Python major/minor version, wheel set, or nearest-neighbor tie implementation.

checks.check: Controlled interruption, permanent history, and distinct recovery
checks.establishes: First marked scientific request has an authoritative injected interruption receipt; its partial directory remains; the recovery uses a new request and directory and all datasets complete.
checks.does_not_establish: Checkpoint resume inside a partially completed classifier call; recovery restarts these small deterministic scripts.

findings.finding: Iris and Zoo print CN/AA/RA/CS labels but hardcode link_predictor='CS'.
findings.resolution: Preserved upstream calls and original scoring; report values are explicitly labeled as printed-row results with actual predictor CS. Genuine separate CN/AA performance is not claimed.

findings.finding: Dropping the first nearest-neighbor index does not guarantee self removal with duplicate features; saved Iris and Zoo graphs contain 1 and 28 self-loops.
findings.resolution: Preserved original graphs and tie behavior; independent scores account for loop degree semantics. No graph repair or substituted result is used.

findings.finding: Single unstratified seed-42 split; Zoo has no class-4 test examples and 15 of 21 test feature vectors equal a training vector; test features participate in the graph.
findings.resolution: Report exact class support and transductive design; retain partition; make no uncertainty, class-complete evaluation, inductive, or population-level claim.

findings.finding: Original environment, reference outputs and full paper were not supplied; README provides no dependency versions or supplied run.sh.
findings.resolution: Infer dependencies from imports, pin and record actual offline versions, retain original provenance, execute the three named scripts, and limit conclusions to the demonstrated local reproduction.

findings.finding: Supplied measurement-specific schemas cover EMA and modular addition rather than CULP.
findings.resolution: Use the common measurement envelope and document a CULP-specific extension with numeric NPZ evidence, actual predictor identity and broker provenance. No unrelated measurements are fabricated.

findings.finding: Deterministic repeatability and a passed CLI alone do not verify scientific results; equal-distance neighbor ordering can depend on library implementation.
findings.resolution: Check saved-label arithmetic, independent graph scores, original data, preprocessing, source scope, and exact repeats. State that boundary tie selection is checked for admissibility only and cross-version equivalence remains untested.
